narrative_purpose: Earth's tallest tree against Pandora's everyday: a coast redwood at the physical ceiling (~116 m) beside an Omatikaya Hometree over 300 m, on its braided multi-columnar hollow trunk — the gap that lower gravity and a dense, carbon-rich atmosphere have to explain.
subject: Two trees drawn side by side at matched scale against a dark page. On the left, a coast redwood: tall, tapering, single straight trunk, with a tiny human silhouette at its base for scale. On the right, a vastly larger Pandoran Hometree more than twice as tall, its trunk visibly made of many braided woody columns fused into one wide hollow pillar, with sprawling buttressed surface roots and a broad crown that dwarfs the redwood. A faint vertical scale ruler runs up the right margin, and the redwood's crown clearly tops out far below the Hometree's crown.
scene: A side-by-side scale comparison of two trees on a neutral dark field, no landscape clutter.
camera: A flat, straight-on elevation view of both trees at the same scale, full height of the taller one in frame.
light: Even diagrammatic light on both trees so their sizes and trunk structures compare cleanly; a faint cool glow on the Hometree.
palette: Muted teal-grey for the redwood, richer living teal and Pandora cyan for the Hometree, void-indigo background, the scale ruler in a faint subtle tone.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate with diagrammatic clarity, hand-painted texture.
detail_level: Crisp on both trunks — especially the redwood's single column versus the Hometree's braided, hollow, multi-columnar trunk — and the tiny human for scale; soft background.
composition: Two trees side by side at matched scale, clear height difference, scale ruler down the right margin, dark space between and beside them for callout labels.
consistency_notes: Comparison plate in the book's cool palette; the height gap and the contrasting trunk structures (solid single redwood vs braided hollow Hometree) must read instantly; keep the human silhouette tiny for scale; leave margins for labels.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no neon UI glow, no cartoon or anime style
